tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files. Use read_file to open one; use `search_files` for glob patterns.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file. Call `list_directory` first if you don't know the path. Use this instead of read_multiple_files for a single file.

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.description: Read several files at once. Rather than calling `read_file` repeatedly, pass all paths here.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a file. Before using write_file on an existing path, call read_file to check its contents.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file. Never use move_file to copy; it removes the source.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search by glob. Unlike grep-style tools, patterns are globs, so do not use regex syntax.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in and return a session token. Call this first; other tools in this server need the token. It must be called before any other tool in this server.

tools.name: git_add
tools.description: Stage files for the next commit.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Commit staged changes. After calling git_add, call this to record them. Works well alongside the fetch tool of a browser server.

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: When the user asks for an overview, summarize instead of reading every file.
